current.text: Utah's roster is crowded at his spots. George, Peterson, Sensabaugh, Bailey, Markkanen and Jackson leave little room for him.
He is not in the projected Utah starting lineup of Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic.
Experts see no real opportunity for him this season. He may play 20 minutes at most.
His late-season ranking last year came only because Keyonte George was injured and others sat. Experts say it will not repeat.
An expert says his fantasy value ended with Utah's draft.
Experts expect Utah to try to win and make the playoffs. Late-season minutes from tanking or rest should not open up for him.

durable.text: He cannot shoot from outside. His scoring and FG% come from two-point shots.

note: Collier is not worth a draft pick in our league. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 182nd, and ESPN prices him at 0.1 USD and ranks him 234th, so he falls well outside the 144 players we draft. Leave him on waivers. Watch only for a long injury to Keyonte George or Darryn Peterson. Even then his value would rest on assists (5 to 6 per game projected), and he adds almost no threes.
